PLAN "Week 5 Deload - Advanced Hypertrophy Recovery"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary recovery:
    name "Dissipate fatigue before intensification block"

PHASES
  PHASE "Deload" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper A - Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 1x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 1x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday training 40m "Lower A - Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x5..6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday rest 0m "Rest / Easy Walk":
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 40m "Upper B - Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          overhead_press 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 2x5..7 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          skull_crusher 1x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 1x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2m
          tricep_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Lower B - Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x4..5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          front_squat 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          pigeon_pose 2m
      DAY Saturday rest 0m "Active Recovery":
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x30 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
      DAY Sunday rest 0m "Full Rest":
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 1x10 rpe 1 rest 0 seconds
